# San Diego Family Vacation Plan: Aug 14–18, 2026

A relaxed 5-day plan for 2 adults and 2 kids, built around beaches, animals, and interactive museums. It stays within the pace you asked for: no starts before 9:30, one post-lunch rest period daily, and no more than 2 paid attractions per day.

## 5-Day Morning / Afternoon / Evening Schedule

### Day 1 — Balboa Park + Downtown Waterfront
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and have a late breakfast near Balboa Park; then explore the park’s gardens and open spaces at an easy pace.
- Afternoon: Visit the **Fleet Science Center** for hands-on exhibits; afterward, take a **rest break** back at the hotel or in a shaded park area.
- Evening: Head to the **Embarcadero** for a casual waterfront dinner and a sunset stroll.

### Day 2 — La Jolla Coast + Sea Life
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Start at **La Jolla Cove** for tide-pool viewing, sea lions, and beach time.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/72/Calidris_alba_at_Ocean_Beach%2C_San_Francisco%2C_California_-_20101116.jpg Alt=Morning: Start at **La Jolla Cove** for tide-pool viewing, sea lions, and beach time, San Diego, Usa
- Afternoon: Enjoy lunch in La Jolla, then take a **rest period** at the hotel or a quiet café before an easy return to the coast.
- Evening: Keep it light with an early dinner and optional short walk along the shoreline or village shops.

### Day 3 — Zoo Day + Park Downtime
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Spend the morning at the **San Diego Zoo**; focus on the animals your kids will enjoy most and use the shuttle to save energy.
- Afternoon: Have lunch, then schedule a **rest period** back at the hotel or in Balboa Park’s quieter areas.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/81/Balboa_Park%2C_San_Diego%2C_CA%2C_USA_-_panoramio_%28206%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Have lunch, then schedule a **rest period** back at the hotel or in Balboa Park’s quieter areas, San Diego, Usa
- Evening: Choose a low-key dinner near the hotel and an early night.

### Day 4 — Mission Bay + Interactive Learning
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Go to **Mission Bay** for beach play, calm water, and a family-friendly start.
Media: Alt=Morning: Go to **Mission Bay** for beach play, calm water, and a family-friendly start, San Diego, Usa
- Afternoon: After lunch, take a **rest period**; then visit the **USS Midway Museum** for interactive ship exhibits and kid-friendly exploration.
- Evening: Have dinner nearby and enjoy a simple bayfront walk if everyone still has energy.

### Day 5 — Waterfront Wildlife + Departure Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Visit **Birch Aquarium at Scripps** for marine life, touch pools, and ocean views.
- Afternoon: After lunch, take a **rest period** and pack up or enjoy a final beach stop if timing allows.
Media: Alt=Afternoon: After lunch, take a **rest period** and pack up or enjoy a final beach stop if timing allows, San Diego, Usa
- Evening: Finish with an early family dinner and departure prep.

## Budget Plan for 4 People

| Category | Planned Spend | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotel / lodging | $1,250 | 4 nights, family-friendly mid-range stay |
| Food & drinks | $900 | Breakfasts, lunches, casual dinners, snacks |
| Paid attractions | $520 | Zoo, Fleet Science Center, USS Midway, Birch Aquarium |
| Local transport | $130 | Rideshares, parking, short transfers |
| Buffer | $0 | Budget is fully allocated |
| Total | **$2,800** | Excludes flights |

## Best Fit for Your Family

- **Top animal days:** Day 2 and Day 3
- **Best interactive museum day:** Day 1
- **Best beach day:** Day 4
- **Most relaxed day:** Day 5
- **Budget safety:** Keep to 1 major paid attraction on Days 1, 2, 4, and 5, and 2 paid attractions only if you swap in a second museum or aquarium visit

- Fleet Science Center visit info: https://www.fleetscience.org/visit/tickets
- USS Midway Museum tickets: https://www.midway.org/plan-your-visit/tickets
